name: netMsgHandlerList
notes: NetMsg dispatch descriptor array, NUL-terminated (name==0). Each entry pairs a message name with the OPD pointer of its handler; walked by NetMsg_Dispatch (0x203AD8), which matches name+1 with I_stricmp and calls the handler via its descriptor. Names come from builtins.csv (NetMsg_ prefix).

name: g_assetPools
notes: XAsset pool pointers by asset type, read by DB_LoadXAssets, DB_FindXAssetHeader, 0x25E2C8, 0x25E918; type 6 (material) = 0xDD8C68. A parallel table at 0xB321C0 is likely the pool sizes (unverified)

name: rb_renderCommandTable
notes: render command handlers as OPD pointers by command id, entry 0 NULL; read at 0x7911B4 and 0x798064. Entry 16 = draw text (0x79AB78). Name inferred

name: svcmds
notes: Server command table walked by SV_ExecuteClientCommand (strcmp). First entry name "userinfo". Entries are {name, OPD/Cmd_Function_s*} pairs.

name: bg_lastParsedWeaponIndex
notes: BG_GetNumWeapons returns it + 1; name inferred

name: bg_weaponDefs
notes: weapon table indexed by BG_GetWeaponDef without a bounds check ("C <n>" server command, re-journal 41)

name: cg_ptr
notes: pointer to cg_t[4] (stride 0x6B100); +0x0 clientNum; client name at + i*0x5D0 + 0x5DB04

name: clientConnections
notes: + localClientNum * 0x35890, see structs.json clientConnection_t; read by CL_CGameNeedsServerCommand

name: g_materialPool
notes: XAsset pool of type 6 (g_assetPools[6]) in the eboot BSS, so a real Material* has a 0 high byte; size unverified

name: g_assetEntryPool
notes: 16-byte entries, index 0 is never used (DB_LoadXAssets builds the free list from 1, 0x26183C); see structs.json XAssetEntry

name: db_hashTable
notes: entry index per hash bucket (hash mod 30000), 0 ends a chain; 62 refs in the DB code

name: g_hudelems
notes: stride 0x7C; address of the in-use byte the newhudelem builtins scan (HudElem_Alloc is inlined); the array may start a few bytes lower

name: level
notes: level.clients at +0x0 (indexed with sizeof(gclient_t)=0x2A38)

name: g_entities
notes: stride 0x2F8 (setclientdvar)

name: g_clients
notes: assigned to level.clients in G_InitGame; count 18 inferred from party_maxplayers max

name: sv_cmd_args
notes: server side CmdArgs read by SV_Cmd_ArgvBuffer and ClientCommand (127 refs), same layout as the client CmdArgs at Sys_GetValue(4). SV_Cmd_Argc is inlined

name: cmd_functions
notes: client command list head

name: sv_cmd_functions
notes: server command list head

name: sv_maxclients
notes: SV_FindClientByAddress loops svs.clients up to ->current.integer (+0x18)

name: svs
notes: +0x1C clients (client_t *, stride 0x651C8), read by SV_GetClientStatInt / SV_FindClientByAddress

name: sv_serverFrameRunning
notes: set by SV_WakeServer, cleared by the server thread when its frame is done and by SV_WaitServer

name: g_dvarCount
notes: compared against 0x1000

name: g_dvarReadLock
notes: lwarx/stwcx reader counter

name: g_dvarWriteLock
notes: lwarx/stwcx writer counter

name: s_dvarPool
notes: stride 0x70

name: s_dvarHashTable
notes: bucket = hash & 0x3FF, chained via dvar_t::hashNext

name: dvar_cheats_ptr
notes: when non-null and current.enabled==0, CHEAT dvars are forced to reset value

name: s_sortedDvars
notes: appended on creation

name: g_dvarsSorted
notes: cleared when a dvar is created

name: scr_errorMessage
notes: buffer filled by Scr_Error

name: statsDDLDef
notes: DDL_Load("ddl_mp/stats.ddl") result stored by 0x6A0208

name: statsDDLRootState
notes: root state of stats.ddl; first argument of DDL_MoveToPath in Cmd_statSetByName_f; followed by cached sub-states (CacLoadouts at 0x2028CC8, emblemstats, clantagstats, consoleinfo …)

name: statsBuffers
notes: per-controller block, stride 0x26694 (LiveStats_GetStatsBuffer); four 0x996D-byte DDL buffers at +0 (stats, kind 0/1), +0x996D (kind 2), +0x132DA (kind 3), +0x1CC47 (kind 5 / basic training, chosen for kind 0 while xblive_basictraining); DDL data starts at buffer+0x28, layout in data/mp/stats_ddl.txt
